issues.description: The script sends location data to discord.com via GM_xmlhttpRequest, which may include user coordinates or game-related information. This is a third-party server and may be used for tracking or data collection.
issues.location: send location to discord (feature, implied by description and GM_xmlhttpRequest usage)
issues.recommendation: Warn users about data transmission to discord.com. Only send minimal necessary data and allow users to opt-out.

issues.description: The script sends reverse geocoding requests to nominatim.openstreetmap.org with user coordinates to obtain address information.
issues.recommendation: Inform users that their coordinates are sent to a third-party geocoding service. Consider caching or minimizing requests.

issues.description: The script requests Notification API permission and can send browser notifications.
issues.recommendation: Ensure notifications are not abused for spam. Only use with user consent.

issues.description: The script applies Proxy wrappers to native prototypes (e.g., Array.prototype.push, Element.prototype.setAttribute, Storage.prototype.setItem, String.prototype.startsWith, fetch) to bypass anti-cheat and detection mechanisms.
issues.recommendation: Modifying native prototypes can introduce compatibility and security risks. Limit scope and document changes.

issues.description: The script requests GM_xmlhttpRequest permission, which allows arbitrary cross-origin requests.
issues.recommendation: Ensure this permission is strictly necessary and not abused.

details: Reads and stores user hotkey and feature toggle preferences via GM_getValue/GM_setValue.
Sends user coordinates to third-party services.

script_name: GeoGuessr OpenGuessr WorldGuessr FreeGuessr Helper Universal
summary: This script transmits user location data to discord.com and nominatim.openstreetmap.org, which are third-party services. It does not appear to collect sensitive user input (e.g., passwords, cookies), nor does it use eval or dynamic code execution. There is no evidence of code obfuscation or DOM XSS. However, the use of Notification API, modification of native prototypes, and broad permissions increase the risk profile. The main critical risk is data exfiltration of user coordinates.
